questions.title: Memoized Fibonacci Output
questions.description: What does the following Ruby code print?
questions.codesnippet:
def fib(n, memo = {})
  return 1 if n <= 2
  memo[n] ||= fib(n - 1, memo) + fib(n - 2, memo)
end
puts fib(6)
